claim: For the valid four-asset correlation matrix \(C=I_4+\frac25A\) defined in RESULT.md, the induced Euclidean condition-number ratio \(\operatorname{cond}_2(e^{-C})/\operatorname{cond}_2(e^{-|C|})\) equals \(\exp((4\sqrt5-8)/5)>1\), while the corresponding Schatten-1 ratio is \(<0.989<1\). Hence the trace-norm ratio is not interchangeable with worst-case Euclidean relative-perturbation sensitivity.
integrity: Exact characteristic polynomials and rational Taylor bounds are reproducible with the included standard-library verifier; numerical decimals are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: One exact four-asset positive-definite correlation matrix establishes a norm-dependent sign reversal. It does not assess empirical predictive performance of global balance or establish a general theorem for all signed networks.
title: A four-asset correlation matrix reverses the condition-number comparison
